hook: 3 skills that quietly separate good Data Analysts from great ones
body:
3 skills that quietly separate good Data Analysts from great ones

I have been thinking about this a lot while working as a Data Analyst in data analytics.

→ Write down what you shipped every Friday. Visibility starts with a record.
→ Say yes to problems, not titles. Problems build the reputation.
→ Ask for feedback before the review cycle, not during it.

From my own experience: I once sent a report without checking duplicate rows, and the totals were wrong until a teammate caught it.

I am open to Business Intelligence Analyst roles. If your team is hiring, my DMs are open.

hook: Steal this structure for your next data analytics project update
body:
Steal this structure for your next data analytics project update

Simple, practical, and you can try it today.

1. Teach it to someone else. If you cannot explain it, you do not own it yet.
2. Block 90 minutes of deep work on your calendar and defend it.
3. Pick one thing. Do it for 5 minutes daily for two weeks. Then review.

From my own experience: A 5-minute data check before sharing saves hours of explaining later.

If this resonated, let us connect. I am always happy to swap notes.
